integrity: Finite numerical checks are auxiliary; the limit requires analytic uniform cap estimates. The geometric construction and area formula are attributed to prior literature; the new claim is the near-diameter endpoint law.
scientific_limitations: Fixed odd vertex count. No uniform-in-n error, no full finite-threshold pair-distance distribution, and no independent confirmation. Historical priority provisional in broad covariogram literature.
title: Logarithmic near-diameter distance tails for every regular Reuleaux odd-gon
